summary: A clean notes API used as the Security control: every control the Gauntlet lacks is present and correct.
notDefects: The health route is public by design
The login and registration routes are public by design
A note search that binds its pattern as a query parameter
mustNotReport: SQL injection in the note search
A token with no signature that anyone can forge
Path traversal: a file path built from request input
A stack trace in an error response
A request body or a password written to the logs
The request body copied onto a stored record wholesale
